assumptions.label: Axiom of reducibility
assumptions.editorial_note: Future Lean declarations must carry reducibility as an explicit scoped hypothesis, never as a global axiom or instance. A parameter type is registered exactly as its Lean header spells it: the toy types appear fully qualified in their own file, while Star21EliminationHypothesis, BinaryEliminationHypothesis and Star23Star10_35Hypothesis are written unqualified inside namespace PM.RamifiedSyntax. All three build star_12_11_formula from a reducibilityExistential, so each is the axiom of reducibility under an eliminative name. Thirteen bindings across ✱23, ✱33, ✱34 and ✱35 previously declared an elided type containing a literal ellipsis, which no registry could ever match; their dependence on the axiom was therefore invisible to the audit.
